verdict.rationale: Fireflies publishes a public pricing page listing features such as AskFred, real-time notes, multi-language mode and audit logs, and its security page names an Enterprise tier. However, the evidence shows no actual prices, no free plan, and no mapping of features to tiers. Missing for 10: evidence of a free starting tier, per-tier price points, a clear tier-by-tier feature breakdown, confirmation that basic tiers are self-serve without contacting sales, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.
